description: This walk visits Lough Graney in County Clare. At the northern end of the lake you'll find a circular walk through a pleasant woodland area running for just over 3km. There's nice views over the expansive lough and paths along the River Bleach which runs into the northern part of the lake. There's also a parking area, a small beach and picnic tables.Head east and you can continue your walking atLough Atorickor by picking up theLough Derg Way. TheGort River Walkis also not too far from the lake.
